headline: Man Walks on the Moon
story:
Two astronauts stepped onto the surface of the Moon tonight, the first people ever to walk on another world. Their lunar module, Eagle, touched down in the Sea of Tranquility with less than a minute of fuel to spare.
The pair spent more than two hours outside, planting a flag, setting up experiments and gathering rocks to bring home. A third crew member circled overhead in the command module, waiting to carry them back to Earth.
Millions watched the grainy pictures live. In the words sent back from the surface, it was one small step for a man and one giant leap for mankind.
caption: An astronaut stands on the Moon, the lunar module reflected in his visor.
